function logicalSizeCase(v) {
  document.body.innerHTML=''; document.body.style.cssText='margin:0';
  const root=document.createElement('main');root.style.cssText='width:200px;height:100px';document.body.append(root);
  const sheet=document.createElement('style');document.head.append(sheet);
  const checks={}, close=(a,b)=>Math.abs(a-b)<.001;
  const make=css=>{const box=document.createElement('div');box.id='target';box.style.cssText=css;root.append(box);return box;};
  const check=(name,css,w,h,rules='')=>{sheet.textContent=rules;const box=make(css),r=box.getBoundingClientRect();checks[name]=close(r.width,w)&&close(r.height,h);box.remove();};
  const base=`width:${20+v}px;height:10px;`;
  check('inline',base+`inline-size:${30+v}px`,30+v,10);
  check('block',base+`block-size:${15+v}px`,20+v,15+v);
  check('minInline',base+`min-inline-size:${40+v}px`,40+v,10);
  check('minBlock',base+`min-block-size:${20+v}px`,20+v,20+v);
  check('maxInline',base+'max-inline-size:10px',10,10);
  check('maxBlock',base+'max-block-size:5px',20+v,5);
  check('logicalLast','width:11px;inline-size:22px;height:10px',22,10);
  check('physicalLast','inline-size:22px;width:11px;height:10px',11,10);
  check('blockLast','height:11px;block-size:22px;width:10px',10,22);
  check('heightLast','block-size:22px;height:11px;width:10px',10,11);
  check('duplicatePhysical','width:11px;inline-size:22px;width:33px;height:10px',33,10);
  check('duplicateLogical','inline-size:11px;width:22px;inline-size:33px;height:10px',33,10);
  check('importantPhysical','width:11px!important;inline-size:22px;height:10px',11,10);
  check('importantLogical','inline-size:22px!important;width:11px;height:10px',22,10);
  check('bothImportant','width:11px!important;inline-size:22px!important;height:10px',22,10);
  check('percent','inline-size:20%;block-size:25%',40,25);
  check('contentBox','inline-size:50px;block-size:30px;padding:2px;border:1px solid',56,36);
  check('borderBox','box-sizing:border-box;inline-size:50px;block-size:30px;padding:2px;border:1px solid',50,30);
  check('minWins','inline-size:20px;min-inline-size:30px;max-width:10px;height:10px',30,10);
  check('maxPhysical','width:60px;max-inline-size:20px;max-width:40px;height:10px',40,10);
  check('maxLogical','width:60px;max-width:40px;max-inline-size:20px;height:10px',20,10);
  check('minimumLast','width:1px;min-width:30px;min-inline-size:40px;height:10px',40,10);
  check('initialInline','width:11px;inline-size:initial;height:10px',200,10);
  check('unsetBlock','height:11px;block-size:unset;width:10px',10,0);
  check('initialMax',base+'max-inline-size:initial',20+v,10);
  check('unboundedMax',base+'max-inline-size:none;max-block-size:none',20+v,10);
  check('variable',base+`--size:${40+v}px;inline-size:var(--size)`,40+v,10);
  check('invalidComputed',base+'inline-size:var(--missing)',200,10);
  check('losingUnsupported','inline-size:2em;width:11px;height:10px',11,10);
  check('horizontal','writing-mode:horizontal-tb;direction:ltr;inline-size:31px;block-size:17px',31,17);
  check('specificity','height:10px',31,10,'div{inline-size:17px}#target{width:31px}');
  check('sourceOrder','height:10px',31,10,'#target{inline-size:17px}#target{width:31px}');
  check('inlineOrigin','height:10px;inline-size:41px',41,10,'#target{width:31px}');
  check('sheetImportant','height:10px;inline-size:41px',31,10,'#target{width:31px!important}');
  check('layers','height:10px',31,10,'@layer early,late;@layer early{#target{inline-size:17px}}@layer late{div{width:31px}}');
  check('importantLayers','height:10px',17,10,'@layer early,late;@layer early{div{inline-size:17px!important}}@layer late{#target{width:31px!important}}');
  check('animation','height:10px;inline-size:17px',51,10,'@keyframes size{from{width:11px}to{width:91px}}#target{animation:size 1s linear -.5s paused}');
  check('animationImportant','height:10px;inline-size:17px!important',17,10,'@keyframes size{from{width:11px}to{width:91px}}#target{animation:size 1s linear -.5s paused}');
  sheet.textContent='';
  const box=make('width:11px;inline-size:22px;height:10px');
  box.style.width='33px';checks.cssomPhysical=close(box.getBoundingClientRect().width,33);
  box.style.setProperty('inline-size','44px');checks.cssomLogical=close(box.getBoundingClientRect().width,44);
  checks.cssomOrder=box.style.cssText==='height: 10px; width: 33px; inline-size: 44px;';
  box.style.removeProperty('inline-size');checks.cssomRemoval=close(box.getBoundingClientRect().width,33);
  box.style.cssText='width:11px;inline-size:22px;width:33px;height:10px';
  checks.parseOrder=box.style.cssText==='inline-size: 22px; width: 33px; height: 10px;';
  box.style.cssText='width:11px!important;height:22px';
  checks.parsedImportance=box.style.cssText==='height: 22px; width: 11px !important;';
  box.style.cssText='--A: one; --a: two; --A: three !important; padding: INHERIT';
  checks.parsedCustomPriority=box.style.cssText==='--a: two; padding: inherit; --A: three !important;';
  box.remove();sheet.remove();
  return checks;
}
